RawView.exampleRecipeSimple:
# Chocolate Cake
---
yield: 8 servings
time: 01:30
---

- flour 300 g
- sugar 200 g
- cocoa 50 g
- eggs 3
- milk 200 ml

1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add eggs and milk.
3. Bake at 180C ~45m.
RawView.helpIntroSimple: Minimal format: title heading, optional meta block, bullet ingredients, steps. Start more recipes with new # headings.
RawView.ruleOptionalMeta: Optional block after title between --- lines with: yield, time.
RawView.ruleIngredientsSimple: Ingredients: one per line starting with - .
RawView.ruleInstructionsSimple: Blank line, then each instruction on its own line (you can add numbers or leave them off).
RawView.ruleBulk: Bulk: just add another # Heading to start a new recipe.
RawView.hintTips: Steps are numbered when displayed; adding numbers yourself is fine too. Keep it simple; extra blank lines ignored.
RawView.llmPromptHint: Paste this into ChatGPT, Claude or another assistant, then add your recipe text after it. The reply can be pasted straight into the editor.
